description: This file is a shell script used for testing git graph visualization features, including various configurations of commit history graphs. It defines test cases that set up git repositories with specific commit and branch structures, then verifies the correctness of the generated graph representations under different display options.

methods.name: check_graph
methods.description: A shell function that outputs the current graph to a specified file and then compares it with the expected output using 'lib_test_cmp_graph'.
